notes.title: Crypterion 1.0 Full Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/eac8eea2dd823e5507a91e7547e50c9b92120a74.jpg

If you’re new to Crypterion, check the store page for a full rundown of its unique features and charm. This announcement focuses on the latest patch notes, highlighting fresh content and improvements for both newcomers and long-time supporters.

Recent Enhancements:
- The Face-to-Face T.V. Show episodes are no longer repeatable, making it more likely to see them all.

- A spy has been added. They’re hidden among the crew—can you uncover them?

- 16 new non-steam achievements, bringing the total to 39. These unlock the path to discovering the lost city of Iclantia.

- The advertisement room now reflects the removal of commodity advertising.

- A VR computer is introduced in the Fun Zone. Because of its intricate Iclantian tech, it will take clever players to figure it out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/83117f34e85dfc15401a657ef358677c1eb32337.png

(the Iclantian tech - unpowered)

- Kickstarter backers now properly appear in the true ending credits.

- Use the universal translator to understand a language.

- A new flier shows up on the bounty board over time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/cf649d49b98bc756d1a143f0e69a5458c1bc59ad.png

- The cat adoption agency is now reachable.

- The Comet Hotline agency is now accessible.

- Two new backgrounds enrich a fresh location.

- The Time room updates upon endgame to hint at hidden secrets.

- A new photo collection system appears in the treasury.

- Renamed the second story-arc (Empress and Faction) to the “Iclantian Arc,” with an option to choose a companion for the journey.

- Asteroid effects updated in the main menu and on planet Umbra.

Great effort went into the art to bring you original characters and hand-painted backgrounds, some of which may appear only once during unique encounters:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/0025e531082463bbe9091a04eb89cb48c13c7c39.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/dad40d0c8c528244e4a04e75ac21add0a0668c5e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/ef06e914b0a880d635a0c67ea257a553c93dc781.png
Astra celebrating me finally making it to 1.0!

Patch Notes:
- Cleared up huge bug that would stop progression if you went ''remain as friends'' rout.
- Opportunity events are no longer missed when the time clock isn’t fixed.
- Prevented being able to start Ice-cream event when Moxie is not present.
- Fixed various typos and made corrections (thanks, Arcanestomper).
- Adjusted some dialogues for smoother flow.
- Prevented overlapping fonts in the Time room.
- Improved shield collision in the flight mini-game.
- Polished certain dialogue to maintain continuity on how to become emperor.
- Vivi no longer appears on the wrong planet background. Missing her on the first visit no longer blocks future appearances.
- Nanami’s gladiator event now only triggers with the proper crew.

Note: Some Early Access requests are still in progress. I aim to add them as quality-of-life updates.

As I've worked hard to reach this point, hopefully I've earned your review, then go check out the previous update which added new opportunities for the player to discover.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048860/view/542217277081125677

Final Thoughts
I felt like I could keep going and adding content forever, but I had to bring it to 1.0 eventually. The 1.0 update focuses mostly on bringing everything together in the time room, which will lead you to the games greatest secret. Previous (post-opportunity update) saved games should work. Although, I've only been able to test my own saved games. Yea, best to start over just in case.

My next update needs a larger player-base since it focuses on the community. Let's see how launch goes and take it from there!

notes.notes:

Details:

This update introduces story moments and lucrative business opportunities that focus on you rather than your crew. These can be discovered while exploring planet surfaces or through specific phone calls from your small business.

The time clock has been overhauled to provide hints (once repaired) about their locations, but they can still be missed or end dramatically if you arrive unprepared. *Content appears early, around the time you reach the station.

Patch Notes:
Features:

 Time clock enhancements to provide clues to help you discover business opportunities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/ec6bbdbe94e4ead45eaf81a4dd4290d5642f754a.png
 Increased planet goods output to accommodate the future new advertisement system.
 Increased default font size to enhance visibility and prepare for mobile gaming platforms.
 Added a new system to allow players to buy planetary cryptos during events.
 Increased the planetary cryptos purchase limit to 300 per visit.
 Made more background objects interactive.
 Added a secret event for players to discover.
 Added a second secret event for players to discover.
 Added secret phone numbers to call.
 Made more store-bought items usable.
 Increased power gain from discovering a specific hidden artifact.
 Added 10 new characters to the cast, appearing throughout your adventure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/4923e35269e79f733f6166cc12d38dc6ba1cf241.png

Lilian - An ancient Numari who holds the secrets of the past.
Sylvar - A disgruntled fleet commander with extensive experience and a troubled history.
Vivi - A mysterious fairy wisp with the power to grant your every wish.
Chase - An information specialist and savvy opportunist.
Sable - A bounty hunter and gadgeteer, skilled in collecting and using advanced technology.
Theo - A shrewd and calculated entrepreneur whose ethics and intentions remain a mystery. 
Cedrix - A wealthy stockbroker and business investor, known for his strategic acumen.
Ranke - A highly decorated elite fighter with an unmatched love for battle.
Cassandra -  Co-director at Vortex Nexus and a key investor in breakthrough technologies.
Taro - A playful spirit juggling part-time jobs, with a passion for drama and a flair for the stage.

Approximately 17 single-spaced pages of new dialogue (8,355 words)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/5329f424f96a4509b31eabe53b00364bdfbeeca7.jpg

 Added two fun interactive quizzes featuring a variety of questions and a reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3b51b53292c7e723d86c0fdf25922b07b3ecea47.png

 New default phone call scenarios
 Now able to earn a broader range of rewards through events, such as ship enhancements and increased popularity
 Added visual clues to help find Astra when missing

Random Events Explained:
I realized during testing that galaxy map side-story events can indeed be missed, either because they don’t appear often enough or they are easy to overlook. For now, I am keeping the system as it is. With time and a sharp eye, players can eventually find all the events. This approach reduces repetitive story moments. The goal was to give each player a unique experience in some way.

At first, the chance of encountering these events is high, but the probability decreases as more are experienced.

Art Enhancements:

SPOILER LOCATIONS:
There are several destinations you will encounter. Build relationships with your crew members and make the hard choices. These are four examples:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/df025f3e7b288cff3df2aef6280803035db1d4fc.jpg

The Auction House:
The auction house opens periodically as you progress the story. Once the main story is finished, it remains open so long as there are items to buy, and you can go as often as you wish.

These are key things to remember when attending an auction:

1) You cannot bid more money than you have (going into debt has been removed). This makes it important not to attend auctions too frequently until you are prepared to win.

2) You can lose an item for good. This makes winning much more rewarding. If you lose, it will become more difficult to obtain the item later, and some items cannot be acquired again.

3) Bidding happens in three stages. You use each stage to determine how much money others are willing to spend. Depending on how much you bid in the first two stages, others may bid more or less. If you can gauge this correctly, you will save much more money during bidding.

4) Easy mode. This iteration of the Auction House is on the easier side for testing purposes. I will balance difficulty for 1.0 release.

notes.title: Crypterion Huge Update!
notes.notes:
This is a long awaited update that brings my previously released roadmap to completion.

What it's about:

Besides typing up patch notes, I want to emphasize that Crypterion is dialogue and choices heavy and is becoming even more so with this update. In most cases, you will not know it's happening, unless you were to play the game over with different choices.

I have about 400-500 pages of dialogue lumped into this small universe. Much of the reading is unique to your playthrough aside from the main story quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/a25e412f53008e7e535e3f8bf7e57786bdc55837.jpg

Crew Events! This image depicts a crew event that may occur in the game. I've used some generated images as placeholders during these events to add visuals to the story. Rest assured, apart from these event images, all graphics in the game were either artist-drawn or purchased assets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/0587c9d3de0ae13dff5510f1188b7f9a5e64edb9.jpg

Crew events are discoverable and can be overlooked. For example: You may discover a unique ship on the galaxy map, but don't have the crew required. Or you just might not see it because you didn't read the newspaper to give you a heads up.

More Choices than Any Visual Novel:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/3fab61af77e280b7225298127c941e9a749f2d77.jpg

That's a big claim, and granted I haven't played many visual novels, but it turned out this way because that's what I always wanted in a visual novel.

In this update alone, I've included 95 amazing choices! I'm seriously insane! Some of these choices carry HEAVY weight... and some small... and some play like mini-games. They can be the difference to finding a new artifact or not. I'll never mention this again, but it's fair to those following the game to get an idea of the fun things you may or may not encounter:

- Learn about Lora's family
- Engage in military missions with James
- Go on dates with other crew members (even if they don't call it that)
- Take a Part time job to earn money with Juniper
- Cook with Thurgium
- Discover corruption with Erand
- Learn Nanami's past
- Combine your wits with Malthus
...

It's hard to see all that is going on. And some things are not apparent on surface level. I should mention that if you are married before you experience some events... they will turn out slightly different :) As does other dialogue based off your choices.

If I may be able to stake my claim that I'm proud of the interactive choices in the game, I will give one more example. At one point in the game you make a choice out of six that leads to many more. As such I describe the choice link as: 6-3-5-5-5-5-1-1-2-2-2 Huge boost if you become emperor
- Made Empress power level more easily passible
- No longer lose coins going into events
- Fixed all Achievements to trigger correctly

Fixes & Troubleshooting:
Fixed - prevent player from leaving ship early
Fixed - Events from repeating
Fixed - Taxes and passenger rates not saving correction
Fixed - Mind Melt game event unlocking early
Fixed - Nanami wrong avatar at fairgrounds
Fixed - Many achievements not unlocking properly

[IMPORTANT]

2) I continually add markers that record what type of choices you make and then sometimes go back to previous conversations to implement reactions to these. As such, when continuing an older save, you miss out on some of these although I try to future proof it as much as possible.

I have some sales coming up to get a discount on the game. I could not schedule it for today because I just wanted to get this patch out. There will be two sales upcoming and then of course the 1.0 release date sale.

notes.title: Crypterion Voyage Update!
notes.notes:
Starting today from Jan 8-15 is the Steam Capitalism and Economy Fest. Besides the heavy discount, I am working on a major update.

What it's about:
Crypterion is perfect for this festival! The primary goal of the game is make money. That money is then spent to make even more money... and then that money is spent on in-game treasures, building and acquiring assets, gifts, and unlocking memorable moments with your crew.

Crypterion is heavy on adventure, dialogue and choices. You go on T.V., become a celebrity, build a small business from the ground up, go on vacation, add paintings to a gallery, attend auctions, and make friends and enemies.

The Voyage Update:
Over a year ago, some files of mine corrupted. That was supposed to be part 2 of Voyage update (found in the old roadmap). In December I set out the daunting task to re-create that content and that is what I'm working to deliver next. These are the details:

The voyage update was meant to provide players with scenarios uniquely their own. As such, you may discover events that other players may not. To do this, I'm expanding the Sunny Dae newsletter to include 52 unique scenarios. Many of these scenarios will appear in the game world to find (most on the galaxy map)

In the current build, you will sometimes notice ships or other objects roaming the galaxy. Clicking these will give you experiences:

- Each event averages 6 pages of dialogue.
- Most events have choices leading to several alternate pages of dialogue. So even thought this will be a content heavy update, there is no guarantee you will find the event, or you will miss half of the content because of a choice you made.
- Events can have rewards

This image was posted in Discord years ago when the channel was formed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/a1fe5ae332f3139fcaf10f089669d682f2d78534.png

Those with a keen eye may have noticed faction leader Jagaimo's shadow did not match his person. It's now time for this mysterious shadow to make an appearance.

The Faction arc, which is started through Astra's end-game romance option, is now complete. There are some things about it that I had a hard time deciding on because it impacts one character quite a bit. I'm still not sure if a later patch I will change the ending to my other idea.

There are 27 news pages of single-space dialogue mixed in this update. This is what they cover:
 - Faction arc (Astra's rout)
 - New celebrity event in the media room
 - Malthus's information shop (name pending approval)
 - Numari Vacation
 - Empress dialogue ending
 - Two more "cursed witch" events
 - End credits mini-game

If you were to skip both Astra and Moxie's routes, you would miss a lot of content. My game would have been a lot longer had I put everything mandatory, but this makes choices carry weight. New players will come across many instances where this is the case. I will continue to add more content so that you can pick your path, but be aware that even in this last update of 27 pages, you may only encounter half or less of that.

Marketplace:
- Buy and use the camera shop item in a special event. That's right! You get to take pictures in a mini-game. *I want the camera to be fun, so I'm creating other scenarios where you can use the camera for the second patch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/110ae54c5d8dbdb6e37e9e61e40dd20a53ee27af.png

Treasury/Fun zone:
- One new artifact appears in the treasury if acquired and will be used later

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/a08b08f183dbe3b0ec16cd4701710d42d31e416b.png

Good news, the shop in the Fun Zone is opening. We asked Malthus what he is selling.

Malthus: "Knowledge of the crew, information, and secrets."

We asked, "Are you sure your information is accurate?"

Malthus: "I assure you are getting the best and most accurate information. I've processed all the data through a highly sophisticated computer... also known as my brain.

This will be the place you can learn more about the crew to help prepare you for the 'Mind Melt' episodes or just fun information in general.

What information are you hoping Malthus will sell?

Media Room:
- New Mind Melt game show!
   > A second show appears for all 6 representatives. If you win, you get to advance a rank. It was hard testing all the combinations of results that you can make with your partner. *crosses fingers that there are not bugs

Achievements & Troubleshooting:
[IMPORTANT] While I am fixing the achievements to work in-game, I am also designing them and the cards and emotes I want to release with v1.0.

Steam still has not approved my game for cards, backgrounds, and achievements. The reason being the engagement overall for the game. You may notice that Steam hasn't even gotten enough reviews to rate the game.

I do apologize for slow updates. I've had many trials this past year but keep developing the game despite setbacks. I'm at the mercy of Steam and its algorithms for acceptance concerning achievement approval, but I'm sure this will happen at full release. No worries :)

I do have about 3 months of work into the "Endless" secret arcade found in Crypterion that I hope to release at some point. I pray that that will happen because it will add tons of content to the game in a very unique way. It's like making a second game to put into Crypterion, so I stopped to focus first on reaching 1.0.

- As far as troubleshooting, there was a bug I discovered in Altear's route where if you helped her with all the Empress duties, you may not be able to attend the Numari vacation. I have fixed this but am hoping this will not be the case for previous players that reached that point.

- Sometimes, drawing the money you collected from planets has an error.

If you want to backup your save, the location is C:\Users\'your user name'\AppData\Local\Crypterion

- Diamond ring can be used

- New event, "your first passengers"
- New event, "the merchants".
- New event, "tips shop".

- Find Juniper's medical license and if she has one. (a fan's special request)

Other:
- Huge quality of life with mouse pointer. Now know what objects you can interact with and who you can talk to. More mysteries to find and click.
- Characters will react differently to you and remember choices you've made previously. (this is constantly being expanded)
- Early game hint system - get suggestions on what to do
- Your Informant crewmate Erand is extremely useful for advice when you are stuck or need to find endgame content.
- Updated James conversation with Millie
- Updated phone conversation with Nanami

Troubleshooting:
- Old save games will load, but will not trigger most new events
- Noticeable choppiness when entering some areas. This is because I've focused more on content over optimization. But, some changes I can make later will really speed things up :)

Example of how I find errors or bugs:
I was so good at paying taxes in the game, that I didn't realize a bug could appear mid-story if I didn't pay taxes after I made a specific dialogue choice earlier. This game is very complex for me to test.

2) Changing the way the auction works so you can visit it any time as long as requirements are met

notes.title: Next Update this May!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35057533/8f9bb6ac28b38f39e753b657d095030a9e16e5a4.jpg

Hi everyone. I'm excited to tell you what's coming next for Crypterion.

The Big Stuff:
- Compete against the Empress for the throne
- Discover a new adversary with ill intent

What makes these two specific events interesting is you can only choose one and they are completely different. They also complete the main story of the game.

It's now time to face-off against the Empress through dialogue challenges. If you have your wits about you, you may succeed. Becoming Emperor has it's perks. You can purchase planets for instance and intimidate people just by looking at them.

In the other event, you will discover a mysterious figure with a devious plan. It's hard to say anything about this event without spoilers. The event focuses on the use of a specific artifact that is meaningful to you.

The Small Stuff:
- A new character and events to help new players
- Story polish, fixes, and better pacing
- Finishing the content found in game, but not useable (like store items)
- Fan art book
- Steam cards and achievements

This update will come out in May. The game was a huge undertaking and I'm sorry for delays. The auction system, T.V. and celebrity system, games-shows, etc. still need more content.

Full Release Date:
There is no release date yet. A release date announcement may come shortly after the May update and 100% will happen this year.

Questions or Content Requests:
Feel free to ask, suggest, or request something. What dialogue events between characters or the player you'd like to see? Or anything else that comes to mind that I can add during early access.
